sloka: या या मे जायते बुद्धिर्येषु येष्वाश्रमेषु च ।सा सा भवतु धर्मिष्ठा तं तु धर्मं च पालये ।। ७.१०.३२ ॥
transliteration: yā yā me jāyate buddhiryeṣu yeṣvāśrameṣu ca ।sā sā bhavatu dharmiṣṭhā taṁ tu dharmaṁ ca pālaye ।। 7.10.32 ॥

translations.english: May whatever thoughts arise in my mind, in whichever stage of life, always be righteous, and may I always uphold that righteousness.
